page.layout: One printed page, title page: a decorative border at the top, then centred lines of imprint, a central woodcut ornament, and the date at the foot below a rule.

main_text.l: Cum priuilegio S. Rom. Imperii vicariatus

page.notes: Decorative woodcut border above the imprint and a central woodcut ornament (triangular floral motif) between the privilege line and the date; a rule lies under "ANNO". The date line is printed "Ioc XXXIV" with a small ornament before it (IↃC in the reversed-C form, rendered here as printed: Ioc = MDXXXIV). Possible show-through is faint and not transcribed.
